(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A humeral implant comprising a first component removably attached to a second component, wherein the first component is a humeral surface component and the second component is a removably attached stem.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The humeral implant of claim 1, wherein said first component is a humeral surface component and said second component is a removably attached stem.

(Currently Amended) Claim 3: The implant of claim 2, wherein said humeral surface component has a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature.

(Currently Amended) Claim 9: The implant of claim 3, wherein said humeral surface component is spherically or elliptically shaped.

(Currently Amended) Claim 20: The implant of claim 2, wherein said removably attached stem has a variable length that is adjustable and extends from a lateral cortex of said humerus to a center of a head of said humerus.

(Currently Amended) Claim 21: The implant of claim 2, wherein said humeral surface component connects to said removably attached stem.
